paragraphs: I'm applying for the Sr. Financial Analyst role on Engine's GTM finance team. I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli in New York, and before that I spent about five and a half years at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. What stands out to me is that this role owns the bookings forecast and the channel targets that come out of it, so the analysis feeds straight into where the company puts its go-to-market money.

At Lenovo I was a Senior Business Analyst for two years, building forecasts and scenario analyses that improved capital efficiency by 15% and running variance and sensitivity analyses on budget reallocation. At JPMorgan Asset Management I built cross-platform analytics to track campaign KPIs, benchmarked marketing-channel budget allocations against peers to find 30% efficiency gains, and built models to evaluate $10M of channel budget.

That maps well to forecasting bookings, digging into channel performance, and turning it into targets and investment calls with GTM leaders. I work in Excel, SQL and Python and I like automating the manual parts. I'd welcome the chance to talk.

outreach: Hi [Name], I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli and I'm applying for the Sr. Financial Analyst role on Engine's GTM finance team. At Lenovo I built forecasts and scenario models that improved capital efficiency by 15%, and at JPMorgan Asset Management I benchmarked marketing-channel budgets and found 30% efficiency gains. I'd like to hear how the team builds the bookings forecast. Would you have 15 minutes for a quick chat?
